results.name: the same seed always builds the same scene, so a reload does not reshuffle the desktop
every scene is bounded: layers are ordered by depth and nothing is empty
parallax is zero at the centre, grows with depth, and is clamped at the edges
a drifting scene stays inside its box for a simulated hour
the scene yields: hidden, throttled or reduced-motion all mean a still frame
a scene picture must be a local picture path, not a URL
cover-fit fills the desk without distorting the picture
the scene id vocabulary is closed
per-window zoom is clamped to a usable range and rounded to whole percents
